items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: He's a barber... Hal Maranto? Hal Maranto, yeah. He was playing piano there at the time. I followed him. In fact, I followed him on the job.

ctx.x: And what other bands did Gillen play with that you know of?

I don't know of any other bands that he played with, Dick. The only time that I had ever played with Bill was at the Fern Dance Hall. After I left the Fern Dance Hall, I'd like to mention that I went to my first nightclub job, or cabaret they called it in the old days, was the Valencia on Bourbon Street. That was about 1927, I think. And I played with a little outfit there. I believe it was Hilton Lamar's brother, Jimmy Lamar, played alto sax. And Chink Martin's son, Chink Junior, played banjo. Buck Rogers played…
I wonder where he got his style. I can't imagine.
